title: DEF CON 18 - Moxie Marlinspike - Changing Threats To Privacy: From TIA to Google
summary: Moxie Marlinspike's DEF CON 18 talk argues that privacy threats have shifted from centralized state databases like TIA to corporate data collection by companies like Google, despite wins in strong cryptography and decentralization.
why: Strongly recommended as a formative talk on privacy, especially for its argument that voting with your feet fails as a privacy strategy.

quote.text: It was formative in my understanding of privacy and security.
